work.title: The Third Part of King Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A Field of Battle near Barnet
scene.location: A Field of Battle near Barnet

content.text: Alarum and excursions. Enter King Edward bringing forth Warwick wounded.

lines.text: So, lie thou there. Die thou, and die our fear,
lines.plainText: So lie thou there Die thou and die our fear

lines.text: For Warwick was a bug that feared us all.
lines.plainText: For Warwick was a bug that feared us all

lines.text: Now, Montague, sit fast; I seek for thee,
lines.plainText: Now Montague sit fast I seek for thee

lines.text: That Warwick's bones may keep thine company.
lines.plainText: That Warwick's bones may keep thine company

lines.text: Ah, who is nigh? Come to me, friend or foe,
lines.plainText: Ah who is nigh Come to me friend or foe

lines.text: And tell me who is victor, York or Warwick?
lines.plainText: And tell me who is victor York or Warwick

lines.text: Why ask I that? My mangled body shows,
lines.plainText: Why ask I that My mangled body shows

lines.text: My blood, my want of strength, my sick heart shows
lines.plainText: My blood my want of strength my sick heart shows

lines.text: That I must yield my body to the earth
lines.plainText: That I must yield my body to the earth

lines.text: And, by my fall, the conquest to my foe.
lines.plainText: And by my fall the conquest to my foe

lines.text: Thus yields the cedar to the axe's edge,
lines.plainText: Thus yields the cedar to the axe's edge

lines.text: Whose arms gave shelter to the princely eagle,
lines.plainText: Whose arms gave shelter to the princely eagle

lines.text: Under whose shade the ramping lion slept,
lines.plainText: Under whose shade the ramping lion slept

lines.text: Whose top branch overpeered Jove's spreading tree,
lines.plainText: Whose top branch overpeered Jove's spreading tree

lines.text: And kept low shrubs from winter's pow'rful wind.
lines.plainText: And kept low shrubs from winter's pow'rful wind

lines.text: These eyes, that now are dimmed with death's black veil,
lines.plainText: These eyes that now are dimmed with death's black veil

lines.text: Have been as piercing as the midday sun,
lines.plainText: Have been as piercing as the midday sun

lines.text: To search the secret treasons of the world;
lines.plainText: To search the secret treasons of the world

lines.text: The wrinkles in my brows, now filled with blood,
lines.plainText: The wrinkles in my brows now filled with blood

lines.text: Were likened oft to kingly sepulchres,
lines.plainText: Were likened oft to kingly sepulchres

lines.text: For who lived King but I could dig his grave?
lines.plainText: For who lived King but I could dig his grave

lines.text: And who durst smile when Warwick bent his brow?
lines.plainText: And who durst smile when Warwick bent his brow

lines.text: Lo, now my glory smeared in dust and blood!
lines.plainText: Lo now my glory smeared in dust and blood

lines.text: My parks, my walks, my manors that I had,
lines.plainText: My parks my walks my manors that I had

lines.text: Even now forsake me; and of all my lands
lines.plainText: Even now forsake me and of all my lands

lines.text: Is nothing left me but my body's length.
lines.plainText: Is nothing left me but my body's length

lines.text: Why, what is pomp, rule, reign, but earth and dust?
lines.plainText: Why what is pomp rule reign but earth and dust

lines.text: And live we how we can, yet die we must.
lines.plainText: And live we how we can yet die we must

lines.text: Ah, Warwick, Warwick, wert thou as we are,
lines.plainText: Ah Warwick Warwick wert thou as we are

lines.text: We might recover all our loss again.
lines.plainText: We might recover all our loss again

lines.text: The Queen from France hath brought a puissant power;
lines.plainText: The Queen from France hath brought a puissant power

lines.text: Even now we heard the news. Ah, couldst thou fly!
lines.plainText: Even now we heard the news Ah couldst thou fly

lines.text: Why, then I would not fly. Ah, Montague!
lines.plainText: Why then I would not fly Ah Montague

lines.text: If thou be there, sweet brother, take my hand
lines.plainText: If thou be there sweet brother take my hand

lines.text: And with thy lips keep in my soul awhile.
lines.plainText: And with thy lips keep in my soul awhile

lines.text: Thou lov'st me not; for, brother, if thou didst,
lines.plainText: Thou lov'st me not for brother if thou didst

lines.text: Thy tears would wash this cold congealed blood
lines.plainText: Thy tears would wash this cold congealed blood

lines.text: That glues my lips and will not let me speak.
lines.plainText: That glues my lips and will not let me speak

lines.text: Come quickly, Montague, or I am dead.
lines.plainText: Come quickly Montague or I am dead

lines.text: Ah, Warwick, Montague hath breathed his last,
lines.plainText: Ah Warwick Montague hath breathed his last

lines.text: And to the latest gasp cried out for Warwick,
lines.plainText: And to the latest gasp cried out for Warwick

lines.text: And said "Commend me to my valiant brother."
lines.plainText: And said Commend me to my valiant brother

lines.text: And more he would have said, and more he spoke,
lines.plainText: And more he would have said and more he spoke

lines.text: Which sounded like a cannon in a vault,
lines.plainText: Which sounded like a cannon in a vault

lines.text: That mought not be distinguished; but at last
lines.plainText: That mought not be distinguished but at last

lines.text: I well might hear, delivered with a groan,
lines.plainText: I well might hear delivered with a groan

lines.text: "O farewell, Warwick!"
lines.plainText: O farewell Warwick

lines.text: Sweet rest his soul! Fly, lords, and save yourselves,
lines.plainText: Sweet rest his soul Fly lords and save yourselves

lines.text: For Warwick bids you all farewell, to meet in heaven.
lines.plainText: For Warwick bids you all farewell to meet in heaven

lines.text: Away, away, to meet the Queen's great power!
lines.plainText: Away away to meet the Queen's great power

content.text: [Here they bear away his body. Exeunt.]
